description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a firearm with a scatter or cone effect, or a shotgun.

Duration constant

Within your first range increment, your Strikes with such a weapon treat a target with lesser cover as having no cover, and a target with standard cover as having lesser cover. Beyond that increment, this weapon's range penalty increases by 1 — you have tuned it for the room you are standing in.

cinderfall.incomplete: on the cover-downgrade half. The range-penalty-increase half is the mirror image of long-iron-discipline's buildable clause (also AdjustStrike/property: "range-increment"-adjacent, but in the penalty- increasing direction) — flagged in Open Questions as a possible partial-REAL companion to that card, not confident enough on its own to call MIXED here. "Ignore/downgrade cover" clauses have no confirmed rule element: the full rule-element/ directory listing contains nothing named for cover. This is flagged rather than asserted as a confirmed absence, since the actual cover-to-AC/Reflex calculation code path itself wasn't traced independently.
